Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje industriale, Fabricația de mase plastice și Fabricația de ambalaje și recipiente
What You Will Enjoy Doing
 At ALPLA, you will help operate and continuously improve the infrastructure behind a global manufacturing company. Our Core Infrastructure team provides reliable and secure infrastructure services for ALPLA locations around the world. We work with modern on-premises technologies as well as Microsoft Azure and are continuously developing our platforms towards a more standardized, automated, and resilient environment. As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will become part of an international team and work with technologies around servers, virtualization, storage, backup, and hybrid cloud infrastructure.
 Your Responsibilities Include
Operate and continuously improve our global infrastructure platforms.
Work with server, virtualization, storage, and backup technologies in an enterprise environment.
Support reliable backup, recovery, and infrastructure resilience solutions. Work with both on-premises infrastructure and Microsoft Azure IaaS environments.
Analyze technical issues and help find sustainable solutions.
Work with both on-premises infrastructure and Microsoft Azure IaaS environments.
Participate in infrastructure projects and the implementation of new technologies
Contribute to the automation, standardization, and modernization of our infrastructure.
Monitor infrastructure services and help ensure stable and reliable operations.
Document technical solutions and share knowledge within the team.
Collaborate with colleagues from different IT teams and locations around the world.
Depending on your experience and interests, you can gradually take ownership of specific technologies, platforms, or infrastructure services.
 What makes you great
 You do not need to be an expert in every technology we use. We are looking for someone with a solid infrastructure background, curiosity, and the motivation to develop further. You might currently work as an Infrastructure Engineer, System Engineer, Systems Administrator, Data Center Engineer, Cloud Engineer, or in a similar technical role.
 What Matters To Us
Experience working with IT infrastructure in a professional environment
Good understanding of at least some infrastructure technologies such as Windows or Linux Server, virtualization, storage, backup, or cloud infrastructure.
Interest in working with a broad infrastructure landscape rather than only a single technology
A structured and solution-oriented approach to technical problems.
Willingness to take responsibility for topics and follow them through to completion.
Interest in improving and automating existing solutions
Enjoyment of working in an international team and sharing knowledge with colleagues
Professional proficiency in English. Experience with Microsoft Azure IaaS, VMware, enterprise backup solutions, storage technologies, scripting, or automation is an advantage – but you do not need to bring all of these skills.
 What you can expect working with us
 The opportunity to work with infrastructure that supports a global manufacturing company with locations around the world.
A broad technology environment covering traditional infrastructure as well as hybrid cloud technologies.
The opportunity to develop your expertise and gradually take responsibility for technologies and infrastructure services.
International projects and collaboration with colleagues across multiple regions.
Professional and personal development opportunities.
A collaborative culture built on trust, openness, and teamwork.
Flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths.
A secure position in a sustainable and growing global company.
